files.freesoundName: Wind blowing in a "fog-catcher" (atrapa-niebla) in the desert of Atacama (Chile)
files.description:
Wind blowing in a "fog-catcher" (atrapa-niebla) in the desert of Atacama (Chile).
The "atrapa-niebla" is on the top on the hills in the desert to collect the water from the cloud coming from the ocean. This king of cloud are calling "Camanchaca" and really specific from this zone.

Sound recorded
files.author: felix.blume
